sentences.text: Copperline files arrived yesterday. Sam, how is ingest looking?
Thirty-eight of forty parsed cleanly. Two are scanned faxes and need OCR tuning.
For Covenant Monitor we still need a feed of covenant terms. Building our own scraper is weeks of work.
Decision: we license covenant data from Ostrander Data instead of building a scraper.
Harbor & Vine will ask about SOC 2 the moment we get serious. I'd like to start evidence collection now.
Agreed. Let's treat SOC 2 Readiness as its own project with a weekly check-in.

summary.action_items:
- [ ] Priya to start SOC 2 evidence collection by 2026-10-01
- [ ] Sam to build an evaluation harness for extraction accuracy by 2026-09-25
- [ ] Dev to get pricing from Ostrander Data by 2026-09-24
